findings.message: U3 (LM5164): V(BST-SW) 5 vs rating 5.5 (91%) (psu/BUCK_BST to psu/BUCK_SW) — above 80% derating

findings.message: external power net iso/VIO_ISO reaches the board without a fuse/PTC on it
findings.waived_by: designer: VIO_ISO is the host's logic supply into U5 side 2 only (<= 4 mA, ISO7721 SLLSEP3G); the host port limits it. A fuse would not open at these currents.

findings.message: Q-1 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Pack range: confirm 13-16S at <= 60 V. Above 60 V leaves ES1/SELV; below 13S the transformer's 30 V output minimum is not met (NA6252-AL would be needed).
Q-2 is BLOCKING and unanswered: BMS interaction: disable the pack BMS's bleed balancing? Is a CAN/RS-485 link required?
Q-3 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Is the battery isolated from mains by the inverter? If so the user barrier can be functional.
Q-4 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Harness: accept 18 AWG <= 1 m, M6 rings and an axial fuse sealed in heat-shrink? Who builds it?
Q-12 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Which pack-BMS signal drives the BMS-OK input (J5)? It must drop on any cell OV/UV or BMS fault.

Q-14 is BLOCKING and unanswered: Multi-cell faults (T1kk insulation failure, reversed harness, ring 0 on B+) drive 320-560 A through two board Nano2 fuses rated 50 A at 125 V; the inline 3AB (10 kA at 125 VDC) is the rated interrupter. Accept series back-up qualified by test F-16, or fund a board fuse with a verified >= 80 VDC / >= 600 A rating?
Pins of type Bidirectional and Power output are connected: Symbol U1 Pin 43 [GPIO5, Bidirectional, Line]; Symbol #FLG02 Pin 1 [Power output, Line]
findings.waived_by: designer: The power output is a PWR_FLAG the emitter adds to nets with power inputs and no regulator output: GND_B (U1 GPIO5-9 tied to V- as unused inputs) and ISO_VCC1 (U5 side 1 is powered from MCU pin PB0, <= 4 mA, so the MCU can remove isolator power when no host is present). Neither is a driver conflict.
